svg.aria-label: Two scatter plots. Each point is one gene. On the left, two screens of the same cell type at different activation states show effects tilted along the diagonal. On the right, two screens of different cell types show a round cloud with no tilt, meaning the effects are essentially unrelated.
svg.text: one perturbation, its effect on every gene, measured in two different screens
both axes span ±0.32 on the log2 scale
both axes span ±0.40 on the log2 scale
